title: CI workflow that runs the tests on every push
when: The user wants tests to run automatically on each push and pull request, with a CI YAML file that is quick, pinned and does not leak anything.
prompt:
Goal: One workflow that checks out the code, sets up the runtime with a dependency cache and runs the test command with read only permissions.
Steps:
1. Save tests.yml where the CI host reads workflows; name: tests.
2. Triggers: push to main, pull_request, and workflow_dispatch for manual runs.
3. permissions: contents: read; a concurrency group of workflow name plus branch with cancel-in-progress: true.
4. One job test on a fixed runner label with timeout-minutes: 15.
5. The checkout and runtime setup actions pinned to full commit SHAs, version in a trailing comment; the runtime version read from .nvmrc or .python-version, cache keyed on the lockfile.
6. Install from the lockfile, then run what developers run (node --test, or python -m unittest discover -s tests).
7. Upload test reports only on failure, with short retention.
Quality bar:
- The job fails on the first broken test within minutes.
- One version file serves CI and developers.
- No step needs a secret to run tests.
Pitfalls:
- Actions referenced by @main or @master, whose code can change.
- set -x or echo of variables that print tokens.
- A cache not keyed on the lockfile, restoring stale packages.
- Tests passing only thanks to global tools on the runner.
Verify:
- [ ] A jobs section and a timeout.
- [ ] Every uses: line points at a SHA or exact tag.
- [ ] permissions is read only.
- [ ] The test command matches the README.
Output: the CI workflow file tests.yml and a status note in README.md.

examples.input: rodar os testes automaticamente em cada pull request
examples.output: tests.yml on push and pull_request, contents read, checkout and setup pinned by SHA, lockfile cache, node --test, 15 min timeout
